title: Sort a List<Employee> by multiple fields using Comparator.comparing().thenComparing()
hint: Chain Comparator.comparing(Employee::getDept).thenComparing(Employee::getSalary) and use reversed() or Comparator.reverseOrder() for descending fields.

title: Convert a List<Employee> into a Map<Department, List<Employee>> grouped by department
hint: Use stream().collect(Collectors.groupingBy(Employee::getDepartment)), which returns a Map from department to list of employees.

title: Demonstrate ConcurrentHashMap's atomic compute()/merge() methods to safely update a shared frequency counter from multiple threads
hint: Use map.merge(key, 1, Integer::sum) or compute() so the read-modify-write happens atomically; run it from many threads via an ExecutorService.

title: Implement a bounded cache using LinkedHashMap with removeEldestEntry() overridden (simple LRU)
hint: Extend LinkedHashMap with accessOrder true in the constructor and override removeEldestEntry to return size() greater than capacity.
